figures_added.what: Labelled rectangle, area 12 m^2 with both sides marked '? m', currentColor strokes/text and soft blue 0.3-opacity fill; makes the product (a x c) and sum (b) hook concrete (Tom's show-what-you-say rule). Caption 'Diagram not drawn accurately'. Self-contained, theme-safe, ~0.8KB.

notes: Factorising quadratics is a textual unit: the exam prints no figures for the factorisation problems themselves (exam-realism test), so no per-problem SVGs or charts were added. The single figure is the opener rectangle, which the opener text claims and now shows. role=img + aria-label present, no external refs, no scripts, no hard-coded dark fills; validator SVG scan clean.
